# Decisions & enforcement

Turn risk evidence into application behavior using the action returned by your site policy.

Source: [site documentation](https://bastionsecurity.io/docs/decisions) · platform revision `44c75b5c6715fb9a30b07e2c3ee319e0ac0810b2`.

<a id="actions"></a>

## Handle every action

| Action | Application behavior |
| --- | --- |
| allow | Continue after normal authentication, payment, and application checks. |
| review | Hold the operation for your fraud-review workflow. Do not automatically fulfill. |
| challenge | Present a challenge or your additional verification flow. Keep the operation pending. |
| block | Stop the operation. Offer a safe support or appeal path where appropriate. |

> **A risk score is not a fraud probability**
>
> Use action for enforcement. A human classification does not independently approve a checkout, and a valid proof does not override review or block. Monitor mode intentionally returns allow regardless of score.

<a id="policy"></a>

## Configure the site policy

**bash**

```bash
curl -X PATCH 'https://api.bastionsecurity.io/api/sites/YOUR_SITE_ID' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BASTION_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"challengeMode":"block","threshold":70}'
```

challengeMode accepts monitor, block, or challenge. threshold is 0–100 and defaults to 70. A blocked account produces block. Otherwise monitor allows; at or above the threshold, enforcement blocks or challenges; below the threshold, scores at least 30 produce review and lower scores allow. Changing the threshold can differ from the named risk-level boundaries.

<a id="evidence"></a>

## Store useful evidence

- Record request_id and action with the attempted operation.
- Keep signal descriptions and scores so analysts can understand the result.
- Correlate external account_id to your customer; webhook accountId is Bastion’s internal account ID.
- Keep payment and fulfillment idempotency separate from scoring idempotency.
- Use confirmed customer outcomes for your review process; a manual review action is not proof of a chargeback.

- [Signals](signals.md) — Understand evidence and its limitations.
- [Custom rules](rules.md) — Express site-specific risk conditions.
